info.title: WasteNot Core API
info.description: Implemented Go core API. AI endpoints are defined in ai/public.openapi.json. Based on Android c1258596cb71bc7b95dc9a4f140f55f759815c4e.

post.description: Same acknowledgement for known and unknown emails. Missing SMTP configuration or uniform TLS availability probe failure returns 503. Only existing accounts receive mail through the durable encrypted outbox.

202.description: Request accepted, not a claim of completed email delivery

post.summary: Replace password and revoke every session
post.description: Pasted opaque recovery token. Valid 15 minutes, single-use, replaced by a new request. Expired, replaced and replayed tokens return 422 INVALID_RESET_TOKEN with field token.

204.description: Password changed and all access/refresh sessions revoked

post.description: Use nonce as the Google ID token nonce. It expires after five minutes and can be used once, including for Google account-deletion confirmation.

post.summary: Exchange a Google ID token for a WasteNot session
post.description: New accounts do not have a password. Sign in by Google subject, not by email. To link a previously unlinked WasteNot account with the same email, obtain a fresh challenge and supply its current password.

401.description: UNAUTHENTICATED: invalid Google proof or existing password

post.summary: Rotate opaque refresh token; reuse revokes the session

delete.summary: Delete authenticated account and owned data
delete.description: Verify the current password or a fresh Google ID token from the linked Google account. Owner data cascades and photo removal/upload intents are durably tracked. 204 confirms physical cleanup including interrupted-upload temporary files. Deferred or locked owner cleanup returns 503 ACCOUNT_DELETION_PENDING after committed account/session removal: clear owner-local state and sign out without reporting a completed purge.

204.description: Account, owned database data and queued private photos removed

403.description: WRONG_PASSWORD with fields.password, or GOOGLE_REAUTH_FAILED for rejected Google proof

503.description: UNAVAILABLE or GOOGLE_AUTH_UNAVAILABLE before commit; ACCOUNT_DELETION_PENDING after committed owner removal with physical cleanup pending

get.summary: Android-compatible enums, limits and feature capabilities
List own active logs with signed, user/filter-bound cursor

patch.summary: Merge supplied fields with optimistic version check

get.summary: Today in account timezone and three most recent logs
Inclusive date range, default seven days, maximum 366 days

has_password.description: True if the account can authenticate with a WasteNot password.
